Name: Delta Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
Wanted to play with a Friend for 1.5 on a modded run through, and asked my friend what he looked for in an idea map, and made one using those rough specifications. Thought I'd share it.

LET ME KNOW IF YOU FIND ANY BUGS

Replaces the Starting Beach Farm with a Delta like farm, utilizing its increased space.
Sprinklers should work Fine on the map [even in the sand].

It shouldn't have any compatibility issues at all with any other mods as far as I understand.

Just download, unzip and drop into your mods folder.
